item.title: Visitors pay respect to Rev. Jesse Jackson at National Civil Rights Museum
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — The country and community are mourning the death of Reverend Jesse Jackson, a Civil Rights leader who worked alongside Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. during the Civil Rights Movement. item.title: Halbert signals interest in 3 county races, including clerk
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — Wanda Halbert has pulled petitions to run for three races in the May 5 primary elections for county offices, including one for her current job at Shelby County Clerk. item.title: 92-year-old Memphis hairstylist makes history
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. —At 92 years young, one Memphis woman is proof that greatness never goes out of style. Eunice Bodie was hired by Sam Gould as the first Black hairstylist at Gould's and she didn’t just remain booked and busy through the decades—she made history, one appointment at a time.
